segments.ja375:1.1: Idāni khomhi sukhito arogo, nikkaṇṭako nippatito kapoto;
segments.ja375:1.3: Kāhāmi dānī hadayassa tuṭṭhiṃ, tathāhimaṃ maṃsasākaṃ baleti.
segments.ja375:2.3: Oraṃ balāke āgaccha, caṇḍo me vāyaso sakhā.
segments.ja375:3.1: Alañhi te jagghitāye, mamaṃ disvāna edisaṃ;
segments.ja375:3.3: Vilūnaṃ sūdaputtena, piṭṭhamaṇḍena [piṭṭhamaddena (sī. syā. pī.)] makkhitaṃ.
segments.ja375:4.3: Kaṇṭhe ca te veḷuriyo, agamā nu kajaṅgalaṃ.
segments.ja375:5.1: Mā te mitto amitto vā, agamāsi kajaṅgalaṃ;
segments.ja375:5.3: Piñchāni tattha lāyitvā, kaṇṭhe bandhanti vaṭṭanaṃ.
segments.ja375:6.3: Na hi mānusakā bhogā, subhuñjā honti pakkhināti.
segments.ja375:9.1: Atha vaṇṇa sasīla hiri labhate, sumukhā visa sāḷiyamittavaro;
segments.ja375:9.3: Atha cakka palāsa sarāja sato, yava bāla kapotaka pannarasāti.
segments.ja375:11.1: Jīnañca vaṇṇaṃ asamaṃvaguppari, sudesitā jātakanti santi vīsati [jātaka pañcavīsati (?)];
